newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down on overseas sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on overseas sales.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold ended easier on Wednesday from the previous New York close after selling from Tokyo was matched only partly by shortcovering from Europe, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$341.40/90 an ounce against New York's US$341.70/342.20 close on Tuesday.
"The Japanese were selling, but the market was not very volatile at all and it all depends on fund action," said one bullion dealer at an international firm.
European shortcovering in afternoon trade pulled gold up slightly, but traders saw bullion testing the downside with support at $340 per ounce.
Some traders reported physical demand was providing support to gold prices, but others said offtake was unimpressive.
Local gold ended HK$36 lower at HK$3,164 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society remained unchanged from its previous fix at -5.00.
